description: This file contains unit tests for verifying Orleans timeout mechanisms, including response timeouts, request cleanup, and call dropping behavior under overload conditions. The tests ensure that timeout exceptions are correctly thrown, tracked requests are cleaned up, and call dropping logic works as expected.

classes.name: TimeoutTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying timeout behavior and request handling in Orleans grains, including handling long-running methods, timeout exceptions, and request tracking cleanup.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Restores the original response timeout after tests are executed.

methods.name: Timeout_LongMethod
methods.description: Verifies that a long-running grain method times out correctly, throws TimeoutException, and request cleanup occurs properly.

methods.name: CallThatShouldHaveBeenDroppedNotExecutedTest
methods.description: Tests the call dropping behavior when a grain is overloaded; ensures subsequent calls are dropped if the first call is still processing.
